batting.name: S Badrinath
batting.dismissal: c IK Pathan b S Sreesanth

batting.name: R Ashwin
batting.dismissal: c LA Pomersbach b IK Pathan

batting.name: S Sohal
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b T Thushara

batting.name: LA Pomersbach
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b M Muralitharan

batting.name: IK Pathan

batting.name: B Lee
batting.dismissal: c JDP Oram b SK Raina

balls.text: full outside off, was in the slot, Balaji tried to clear the leg-side field, made no contact, as usual in this innings, and managed to squeeze a bye
length ball outside off, makes room and crunch it to extra cover, manages a quick single

run out, aiming for the yorker, landed full on the off, tried to drag it over midwicket, mistimed it wide of deep square leg, an accurate throw at the striker's end and Sangakkara clipped the bails to find Thushara just short, another one down
full outside off, makes room and drive that through to deep cover, just a run
tries to be a little cheeky this time, misses out on the paddle scoop, he's no Dougie Marillier, but Sangakkara fumbles to allow them to scamper back for the second
length ball outside off, has a blind and wild swing at it, makes no contact
he's moved away too far, failed to reach it in the end as Lee hurled it wide of the off stump, end of another tidy spell, just 16 off his four overs, well done
superb yorker, swinging into middle, does well to dig it out, bowled even quicker this time, at 148.2 kmph
a bouncer again, but the umpire hasn't called it, wasn't too high, bowled quick at 142.7 kmph, went for the pull but was nowhere near it, was beaten by the pace
bouncer banged in on leg stump, Thushara bends low to let it go
slower one bowled short on the off, picked it at the last moment, dropped it short of point for a quick single
bouncer from Lee, a snorter outside off, Balaji evades it comfortably
he's gone now, good length outside off, makes room to clear extra cover but mistimes it completely, Pomersbach runs back a couple of steps to take a dolly
he finally makes contact, short outside leg stump, moves across and taps it well wide of a squarish fine leg for a boundary

Oram goes! Length ball and he was tempted, took his left foot out to smack that over the bowler's head, ended up slicing it really high and Irfan waited ages for it to come down before snapping it in his palms over his head
he was gone had that hit, length ball outside off, driven uppishly, lands short of cover, Yuvraj takes aim but misses
he's wasting deliveries here, Irfan comes round the wicket and he shuffles across to play the paddle scoop, misses again
full and wide, driven straight to deep cover for a single
too wide, Oram wisely let it go to gain the extra ball
misses out, slower one bowled at 121 kmph, moves well across to help that one its way past fine leg, misses, went over the stumps, just two off the over
short of a length outside off, made room to slash that through third man, missed, what a tidy over, he bowled a similar one to Maharoof
full toss, but bowled really quick, pushed straight to midwicket
bouncer on the off, Ashwin was late to react, tried to upper cut that past the keeper but made no contact
was in the slot, length ball on middle, made way to drill that through the off side, ended up getting an inside edge just wide of short fine for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, tapped down to third man for a single
fullish on middle, driven down to long-on for a single to bring up the 100, it's been a struggle
straying down the leg side, tries to steer it fine but mistimes it to Lee at short third, just a single
slower one, continues to persist with the offcutters, swung wide of Yuvraj, hardly any timing, manages a single for his efforts
slightly short on the off, comes down the track and slaps it straight to cover, sets off for a single but is wisely sent back, survives a shy at the stumps
back of a length on the off, turned down to midwicket
shortish on leg stump, pushed back, slightly uppishly, past the bowler for a single to long-on
slightly short, gets back and punches it back to the bowler
tossed up outside off, pushed to cover off the front foot
went after one too many, gave it some air, but held it back, bowled it short on middle, Gony rocked back to go for the pull, missed as the ball spun away to clip his pad and crash into offstump
powerfully struck again, drilled into the ground but straight to Chawla
that was coming, bowled in the slot, flighted on the off, takes it on the half-volley and swings it miles over deep midwicket for a massive six, Chennai needed that
quicker one bowled full on the off, drops it short of cover and squeezes a single
the offcutter again, short outside off, dragged down to deep midwicket for a single
angling down leg, moves away to flick it square, is hit high on the pads, scrambles a leg bye
slightly short on the off, pushed to cover off the back foot

the pressure was on with the boundaries not coming, and Raina has snapped. Bowled short outside off, made room to cart that over point, got a thick outside edge straight to Lee at short third, Punjab are chipping away here, it was the offcutter
slightly short outside off, swats it powerfully but straight towards Yuvraj at cover who gets his hands on it to keep them to a single
goes after it, bowled slightly sort on middle, tries to dispatch it over deep square leg, mistimes it, gets a single
slightly short on the off, rocks back and punches it down to long-off
pushed into the vacant leg-side field behind the bowler for a single, Chawla runs back, flicks it back in to keep them down to a single
a tad quicker outside off, gets forward to defend, gets a thick edge down to cover
on middle and leg, worked away in front of square for a single
tossed up on the off, eased through to deep cover for a single
Oram goes for the sweep immediately, tossed up outside leg, gets a bit of a top edge but lands safe, gets a couple
end of an excellent spell, short of a good length on the off, defended off the back foot, cautiously
back of a length outside off, waits for it and runs it to third man
slower one bowled on a good length outside off, an attempted legcutter, failed to pick it, hung his bat out but missed
short of a good length outside off, guided to point off the back foot
that was coming, we haven't seen much of him this season, and it's about time he announced his presence, short on middle, makes room and pulls it away wide of mid-on
slightly short on the off, tapped to cover off the back foot
attempts the sweep and is struck on the pads, but that may just have pitched outside leg
quicker one bowled short on the off, just manages to bring his bat down in time as it keeps low
pushed outside off, played it towards cover and refuses the single this time

appeal for run out, dabbed behind point, a bit of a misfield by Chawla who recovers well to return a good throw to Powar at the non-striker's end, Powar collects it in front of the stumps and in the attempt strike them down, makes contact with the elbow than the ball, Oram is safe
quicker one this time, bowled short on the off and spinning away sharply, tries to nudge it square, misses, Sangakkara clips the bails and appeals but he is well in
tossed up on the off, defended between cover and point for a single
short and wide, close to being a wide but the umpire doesn't free his arms

superb yorker!! Dhoni was totally done in by the inswinger, bowled in the high 140's, he was surprised by the pace, failed to bring his bat down in time and the offstump was pegged back. Punjab have the advantage now
bowled on a good length on middle, turned away into the leg side between square leg and midwicket for a couple

a wicket at the stroke of the timeout, now how many times has that happened? Short on the off, goes for the pull in an attempt to clear midwicket, it gets onto him a little too quickly and he lobs a dolly to Irfan at mid-on
signs of aggression, fullish outside off, moves away and slices it through point, wide of third man for a couple
length ball on the off, gets forward and plays it into the leg side, towards deep midwicket for a single
draws him forward by tossing it, gets forward and pushes it back
safe shot, full and wide, takes it on the half-volley and chips it wide of long-off for a single
slightly flatter, bowled full on the off, driven down to long-on for a single
flighted on the off, taps it short of cover and is off
flighted outside off, spins in and he dabs it short of point for a quick single, in fact it just brushed his pads
slightly short on the off, pushed to midwicket off the back foot
too close to the off stump but does well to open the face at the last moment to run it down to third man
angling into the right hander, lets see how he bowls to him, pushed into the off side from the crease
slightly short on the off, punched through to deep cover for a single

shot of the innings, though it was a ball that deserved the treatment, full outside off, in the slot for Raina, who gets to the pitch and flays that imperiously wide of deep cover for a one bounce four
too wide, too short, Raina fails to reach, is called
struggled with his timing the last few balls, this one's overpitched, ideally he would have creamed that through cover but closes the face slightly to push it straight to mid-off
mistimes a cut, gets an under-edge well short of the keeper
tossed up on the off and spinning in, reaches forward and defends with bat close to pad

trying to be a little too cheeky there, was too close to cut, a quicker one off the arm on middle, made room to chop it down, but instead dragged it onto the stumps, perhaps his only lapse, but costs him his wicket
tossed up on leg stump, spinning into the left hander, dropped between point and cover and he's off
much flatter, shortish on the off stump, chopped to deep cover
flighted on middle, pushes through the line, gets a thick inside edge wide of midwicket
straying down leg, giving it a lot of air, swept down to short fine for a single
much better, short of a good length on the off, rocks back and defends it to cover, end of the Powerplay, Chennai have done well
full and wide, mistimed an attempt at a powerful drive to mid-off
bowled on a length on the off, pushed firmly wide of Chawla for a quick single, brings up the 50
a hit and a miss, looks to blaze it through point again, had a flourish on that shot, didn't make contact
positive from the outset, short and wide again, what's Sreesanth doing? He's lucky that didn't go square, slashed it down to third man

dropped, Chawla spills it moving to his right at cover point, fiercely struck, short and wide and he cuts it powerfully off the back foot, got a finger to it Chawla but it sped to the ropes, he'll take some time to nurse it now
Parthiv's looking good, tossed up outside leg stump, sweeps it down really fine, connects well to take it to the boundary

run out, flighted outside off, drew him out of the crease, drove it to Yuvraj at mid-off and set off for the single, dived full length forward to make it but the Punjab captain scored a direct hit at the non-striker's end, replays show he was short
slightly quicker on leg stump, whipped away wide of long-on
flighted on middle and off, chopped down to point
struck uppishly but in the gap, just wide of Simon Katich at point, cut away but didn't get hold of it as well as he would have wanted, still had enough legs to take it to the ropes
slightly short on the off, spins away, moves back and chops it to cover
beaten this time, altered his pace, pushed it at 114.9 kmph, the legcutter to the right hander, drove at it but was beaten by the movement
slightly short on middle, moves back and punches it short of mid-on for a single
picked it beautifully, he's shrugged off his poor form in the early phase of the tournament, length ball on middle, moved across and clipped it way over midwicket for a big six
just a hint of movement into the batsman, pushes it from the crease to mid-on
appeal for lbw, rapped on the pads, moved across to clip it square, but replays indicate it may have been sliding down
through the gap, spotted the slower one, waited for it to come on and flicked it elegantly between square leg and midwicket for a boundary, a confident start this
overpitched outside off, inviting him to drive, Bailey presents the full face to punch that to mid-off
chased it, and did so really hard, short and wide, got a thick edge well over slip and wide of third man for four more
struck him on the ribs as he went for the pull, hurled at 149.6 kmph, got an edge straight into his body, landed short of midwicket and they were off
slower one banged in short outside off, drags it wide of square leg for a single
easily done, drops it short of cover and scampers off for a quick single
bouncer banged in on middle, Parthiv backs away from it
he's lucky, full and wide, looks to swat it over mid-off, gets a thin inside edge just wide of the offstump to beat the keeper to the fine-leg boundary
probing length outside off but there's absolutely no movement, reaches for it and steers it down to third man
a busy player Bailey, moves across and whips it towards deep square leg
poor ball, but just a single as he slashes it down to a squarish third man
shaped away just a touch, moved across and pushed it back to Irfan
uses his wrists beautifully, length ball on middle, gets front and across and drives it through the midwicket region for a boundary, excellent start
nicely timed, back of a length, a little close to the offstump, Bailey rocks back, stands tall and crunches it over point for a boundary wide of third man, spoils what was otherwise a tidy over
kept a little low, pushed him back with a shortish delivery on middle, rocks back and defends it back to the bowler
right on target, bowled full and straight on the off, at 147.9 kmph, defended in front of cover
slower one this time, pushes it gently towards cover for a quick single, a shy at the stumps and almost an overthrow, needless as Parthiv was well in
back of a length again, guided towards point, calls for a single but is sent back, right call
short of a good length on the off stump, rocks back and defends it towards mid-off
bowled short on leg stump, tried to work it square, was hit on the pads, it's all over
length ball on the off, chips it towards long-on
full length outside off, mistimes a swat, plays it back to Balaji who fields well stretching to his right
is fortunate, he's trying his best here Powar, low full toss outside off, tries to drill it through the off side, gets an inside edge to the fine-leg boundary
slower one outside off, had a massive swing at it, missed, made no connection
superb fielding by Raina in the deep, full outside off, struck cleanly wide of long-on but Raina dives full length to his right, to drag it back in
slower one wide of the off, squeezed over point, wide of third man for two runs
the end is near, full toss again, one of many this over, fails to clear long-off, strikes it straight to Oram who cups it comfortably
full toss outside off again, made room to strike it over point, ended up slicing it wide of third man for two more
low full toss outside off, it's over folks, this is going just one way, drags it back to the bowler
low full toss outside off, makes room and slices it wide of deep point
too wide outside off, somehow gets his bat to it, goes off the bottom wide of third man for a couple
sliding on the leg stump, looks to hoick it over square leg, misses and is struck on the pads, gets a leg bye
finally makes contact, fullish on middle, comes down the track and chips it wide of long-on for a couple
pushed it a touch fuller, had a wild swing at it, missed, was nowhere near it, signs of desperation more than anything else
short outside off, chases it, goes for the cut, misses
dropped at short fine, short on leg stump, swung straight through Gony's fingers at behind the wicket, a terrible miss
short of a good length outside off, dabbed behind point for a single
on middle and leg, pushed off the front foot wide of midwicket for a single, another spinner completes a successful spell, 2 for 17, well done
down the leg side, given a wide

Punjab are sliding now, short on middle, struck it hard but failed to get the desired elevation, landed safe in the hands of Oram at long-on, he doesn't drop it this time, as he had in the last game, Chennai have it all wrapped up now
slightly short on middle, pushed off the front foot to cover for a single
short on the off stump, flat bats it back to the bowler,. Raina fumbles and allows a single
quicker one on middle, saw him come down and hurled it short, went for the pull but mistimed it back to the bowler
finally, short of a length outside off, makes room, rocks back and smashes it into the gap between long-off and deep cover
slightly short outside off, punches it to deep cover off the back foot, this simply won't do
almost yorks himself there, dug out back to the bowler
pushed back to the bowler off the front foot
he's trapped him in front, floated it full and he was tempted into playing the sweep, tried to play it square but was rapped on the pads, replays indicate it would have clipped leg stump
short on middle and leg, rocks back and works it away wide of midwicket for a single

uses his height so pluck it over his head, Punjab are on the mat now, tossed up on middle, Sanga came down the track and tried to chip it over the bowler but Ashwin's a tall man, intercepted it with a perfectly-timed leap to get his hands around it
using their feet a lot more now, something they ought to have done much earlier, bunts it down the ground for a single to long-on
flighted outside off, steps out again but miscues this wide of deep cover
Murali fumbles in the deep to concede the second, driven hard wide of him but he was put under pressure, some good running there
dropped, a really tough chance, came down the track and smashed it straight to Raina who was late to react, struck really hard
short and wide, misses out, was there to cut, he tried to do exactly that but made no contact
quicker one on middle and leg, nudged short of square leg for a quick single
slower through the air this time, tucked behind square to keep the strike
saw him come down, hurled it quick on the off stump, dug out wide of cover for a single
the sweep wasn't on, bowled short outside off, spun in to strike him on the arm
flighted outside leg, swept down to short fine for a single
goes for the reverse sweep, slightly short on middle, paddles it wide of slip for a single
tossed up outside leg, tickled to short fine for a single
flighted outside off, driven straight to cover, the end of another successful over, two in a row after the timeout
spinning into the right hander from outside off, struck outside the line as he came forward to defend
is that the decisive blow? Bowled short on middle, Yuvraj made room to bunt it through the off side, it kept a little low and he missed it completely to watch his legstump pegged back
slightly short on the off, punched off the back foot to long-on
went on straight, a dibbly dobbly on the off stump, defended back to the bowler
gives him the charge and drills him down the ground to long-on
short outside off, makes room and punches it to deep cover, ends a superb spell, four overs for eight runs and two wickets
the doostra, quicker on middle and spun in, whipped away to square leg
flighted outside leg, went for the sweep, missed, not called
quicker one bowled on a good length outside off, hit on the pads as he tried to defend, but outside the line
flighted on the off, driven down the ground to long-off, comfortably done
what a timely wicket, flighted on middle, gave it air this time, and got it to spin away sharply just as Pomersbach was sucked into the drive, got a thick edge straight to Raina at slip
slapped into the ground, and over the bowler for a single to long-off
comes down the track, takes it on the half-volley and drives it down to long-on
quicker one bowled full on the off stump, drilled into the ground and back to the bowler
round the wicket to the left hander, tries to sweep it fine, brushes the pads and they manage a leg bye
slips it quick to rap him on the pads but would have gone down
outside leg stump and spinning in, dropped short of square leg, decides against the run
slightly short on the off, slapped away to deep cover off the back foot
tossed up on legstump, tries to work it square, it spins away to produce a thick outside edge towards point
slightly quicker on the off, waits for it and dabs it at the last moment behind point
oooh, almost had him there, short on the off and spun away to just miss the offstump and he failed to connect a pull
quicker one on leg stump, turns away just as Yuvraj tries to close the face, gets a leading edge into the off side
coming round the wicket and slips in the doosra, doesn't quite pick it and is half-forward, fortunately for him he gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to defend
tossed up outside off, driven down the ground to long-off
quicker one bowled flat outside off, left alone to the keeper, went straight through
slightly short on middle, moves back and pushes it down to long-on for a single
tossed up on the off, driven off the front foot to cover
bowled flat and full on the off stump, defended watchfully off the front foot
short and wide, cuts it hard, but straight to the fielder at deep point, just a single
slightly short on the off, waits for it and guides it towards third man to get off the mark, Thushara falls over in his delivery stride
misses out on the pull, short outside off, goes for his trademark pull but makes no contact, the pressure builds
short one on middle, bowled at 126.6 kmph, too few balls pitched up in this innings, takes him a little by surprise, almost gets a leading edge but adjusts well in the end
straying down the leg side, misses out on the glance down fine but gets an extra ball nevertheless
bouncer banged in on middle, ducks under it easily
short of a good length outside off, waits for it and dabs it down to third man for a single
quickish on leg stump and spinning in towards middle, defended onto the pitch with bat close to pat, stifled appeal turned down

are we in for another close one here? He's bowled him round his legs, bowled quickish and short outside leg, walked across to work it fine but had left a wide gap, missed, and the leg stump was uprooted
tossed up outside off, eased through to deep point for one more
quicker on middle and turning away, pushed back to the bowler
tossed up outside off, swatted down to long-off for a single
bowled on a good length outside leg, clipped towards square leg for a single
quicker one on leg stump, tries to tuck it behind square, misses, is hit high on the pads, a decent start for Ashwin
slightly short on the leg stump, worked away into the leg side but again a dot ball
flighted on leg stump, pushed away to midwicket
dropped, came down the track and drove it uppishly towards Balaji at extra cover, he flung himself to his left but couldn't quite hold on, wouldn't be fair to call it a drop, was a toughie
on middle and off, reaches forward and defends it back to the bowler
shortish on the off, pushed away wide of long-on for a couple
flighted on middle and off, gets a stride forward and plays it back to Murali
tossed up this time, outside leg again, kicks it away with his pads
bowled flat on leg stump, pushes it back to the bowler
on middle and leg, pushed away wide of mid-on for a single
the doosra, took it on the half-volley and defended it into the off side
quicker one bowled on a good length on middle, defended into the off side
back of a length outside off, played down to third man for a single to keep the strike, Punjab are gradually opening up now
straying on the pads, moves across and clips it away stylishly to the fine-leg boundary, almost got the security guard's backside, only for the chair to behind him to prevent any damage
plays the pull again, the ball appears to be hurrying on to him, a bit of a groan as he played it, got it into the gap though, wide of fine leg for a couple more
slightly short on leg stump, tried to pull it over square, the shot was on but got an inside edge onto the thighs
angling it in on middle and leg, whipped away to square leg
it's gone all the way, banged in short on middle, came down the track to pull it over midwicket, got the top-edge and it sailed over the fine-leg boundary
good length on the off, moves across to defend it to mid-off, they're taking their time here, or being made to, the Chennai bowlers have kept it tight
he's off the mark, length ball on middle, pushed away wide of mid-on for a single
back of a length on the off, cramping him for room, pushes it back to the bowler
slightly short outside off, bowled at 128.4 kmph, left alone to the keeper
tucked away in front of square off the back foot for a single
nicely done, seized on the chance, short and wide, made room and cut it away over point to beat third man to the boundary
good length on middle, worked away to midwicket on the front foot
he's gone, bowled short on leg stump at 130.2 kmph</i< shuffled across to work it away fine off his hips, gets a faint touch to his glove and Parthiv snaps it easily, first blow!
short and wide, too wide actually, chases it but misses, called by the umpire
back of a length outside off, moves towards it, opens the face but there's a short third in place
a touch fuller on middle and leg, defended into the leg side towards square leg
angling down leg, walks across and nudges it down to fine leg
slightly short on middle, gets back and drops it short of square leg for a quick single
back of a length on the off, dropped short of the bowler on the back foot and scampers a quick single, good response from Katich who was heading for the danger end
bouncer on middle, the speedometer says 116 kmph but it was definitely faster than that, Sohal ducks under it well
short and wide, plays at it from the crease and away from his body, cuts it over point, just wide of third man, for a single
hurls it short on the off, dropped behind point for a single to get off the mark
beaten again, pitched it up and Sohal was sucked into the drive, got the ball to deviate off the pitch to beat the outside edge
beats him straightaway, shoots away off the pitch and caught Sohal prodding at it off the back foot
